SELECT transreg, transtime, 
  risk_indicators->>'spoofprob' as spoofprob,
  risk_indicators->>'frontscore' as frontscore,
  risk_indicators->>'qstuffindex' as qstuffindex,
  risk_indicators->>'washsus' as washsus,
  risk_indicators->>'layerind' as layerind
FROM transactionrecord LIMIT 5;

SELECT cc.compreg, cc.risksc, tr.transtime, 
  tr.risk_indicators->>'spoofprob' as spoofprob,
  tr.risk_indicators->>'frontscore' as frontscore,
  tr.risk_indicators->>'qstuffindex' as qstuffindex,
  tr.risk_indicators->>'washsus' as washsus,
  tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind' as layerind
FROM compliancecase cc
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON cc.transref = tr.transreg
LIMIT 10;
SELECT MIN(risksc), MAX(risksc), AVG(risksc), COUNT(*) FROM compliancecase;

-- Let's see what a simple composite looks like for a few records
SELECT cc.compreg, cc.risksc as current_risk,
  (tr.risk_indicators->>'spoofprob')::numeric + 
  (tr.risk_indicators->>'frontscore')::numeric + 
  (tr.risk_indicators->>'qstuffindex')::numeric +
  CASE tr.risk_indicators->>'washsus' WHEN 'Low' THEN 0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 50 WHEN 'High' THEN 100 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind' WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 25 WHEN 'Confirmed' THEN 50 ELSE 0 END
as raw_activity_index
FROM compliancecase cc
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON cc.transref = tr.transreg
WHERE tr.transtime >= '2024-01-01'
LIMIT 10;

-- Try a simpler composite - just summing the key numeric risk indicators
SELECT cc.compreg, cc.risksc as current_risk,
  ROUND((tr.risk_indicators->>'spoofprob')::numeric + 
        (tr.risk_indicators->>'frontscore')::numeric + 
        (tr.risk_indicators->>'qstuffindex')::numeric * 100 +
        CASE tr.risk_indicators->>'washsus' WHEN 'Low' THEN 0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 33 WHEN 'High' THEN 66 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind' WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 25 WHEN 'Confirmed' THEN 50 ELSE 0 END, 2)
as activity_index
FROM compliancecase cc
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON cc.transref = tr.transreg
WHERE tr.transtime >= '2024-01-01'
LIMIT 15;

-- Try using just the numeric fields scaled down, plus enum contributions
SELECT cc.compreg, cc.risksc as current_risk,
  ROUND(LEAST(
    ((tr.risk_indicators->>'spoofprob')::numeric + 
     (tr.risk_indicators->>'frontscore')::numeric / 100 +
     (tr.risk_indicators->>'qstuffindex')::numeric * 100 +
     CASE tr.risk_indicators->>'washsus' WHEN 'Low' THEN 0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 33 WHEN 'High' THEN 66 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind' WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 25 WHEN 'Confirmed' THEN 50 ELSE 0 END) / 2,
    100), 2) as activity_index
FROM compliancecase cc
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON cc.transref = tr.transreg
WHERE tr.transtime >= '2024-01-01'
LIMIT 15;

-- Test the full update query first with a SELECT to verify
SELECT cc.compreg, cc.risksc as old_risk,
  ROUND(LEAST(
    ((tr.risk_indicators->>'spoofprob')::numeric + 
     (tr.risk_indicators->>'frontscore')::numeric / 100 +
     (tr.risk_indicators->>'qstuffindex')::numeric * 100 +
     CASE tr.risk_indicators->>'washsus' WHEN 'Low' THEN 0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 33 WHEN 'High' THEN 66 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind' WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 25 WHEN 'Confirmed' THEN 50 ELSE 0 END) / 2,
    100), 2) as new_risk
FROM compliancecase cc
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON cc.transref = tr.transreg
WHERE tr.transtime >= '2024-01-01';

UPDATE compliancecase cc
SET risksc = ROUND(LEAST(
    ((tr.risk_indicators->>'spoofprob')::numeric + 
     (tr.risk_indicators->>'frontscore')::numeric / 100 +
     (tr.risk_indicators->>'qstuffindex')::numeric * 100 +
     CASE tr.risk_indicators->>'washsus' WHEN 'Low' THEN 0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 33 WHEN 'High' THEN 66 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind' WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 25 WHEN 'Confirmed' THEN 50 ELSE 0 END) / 2,
    100), 2)
FROM transactionrecord tr
WHERE cc.transref = tr.transreg
  AND tr.transtime >= '2024-01-01';
